def week_number_simple(year, month, day):
    month_days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    is_leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
    if is_leap:
        month_days[1] = 29
    day_of_year = day + sum(month_days[:month - 1])
    return (day_of_year - 1) // 7 + 1
